mapper.select: SELECT cr.OPERATOR_CODE AS AUTHOR_CODE, m.NAME AS AUTHOR_NAME, m.EMAIL AS EMAIL, cr.ACTIVITY_NAME AS AUTHOR_NICKNAME, cr.CREATOR_INTRODUCTION AS INTRODUCTION, cr.ACTIVITY_REGION AS ACTIVITY_FIELD, cr.SNS_URL AS KAKAO_URL, cr.PROFILE_IMAGE AS PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, cr.APPROVAL_STATUS AS OPEN_STATUS FROM CREATOR cr JOIN MEMBER m ON cr.MEMBER_CODE = m.MEMBER_CODE WHERE cr.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode}
mapper.update:
UPDATE CREATOR
ACTIVITY_NAME = #{authorNickname}, CREATOR_INTRODUCTION = #{introduction}, ACTIVITY_REGION = #{activityField}, SNS_URL = #{kakaoUrl},
PROFILE_IMAGE = #{profileImagePath},
WHERE OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode}
